description:
Save anything from anywhere—recipes, movies, books, places, people, trips, notes, todos, and more. Recalo turns every save into a structured, searchable item instead of another forgotten bookmark. Save reels from Instagram or TikTok, links and photos from the web, and useful notes or todos from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI assistants.

Use Recalo inside ChatGPT to search, open, and act on what you’ve saved. Ask ChatGPT to plan meals from your recipes, turn the ingredients into a grocery checklist, share the list, and add reminders. When it’s time to cook, open the recipe in the Recalo app for Cook Mode with step tracking, built-in timers, serving scaling, unit conversion, and notes for next time.

Recalo also brings everything you’ve saved back into the conversation. Pull up a trip itinerary and add new hotel bookings, find a five-minute todo, update a checklist, or remember who recommended something and what you thought.

Everything stays organized in your private Recalo library and synced across iPhone, iPad, the web, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI assistants.

defaultPrompt: Save this New York itinerary and share it with Sarah
Create a trip prep list and add reminders for hotel bookings
Add groceries for that greek tofu scramble recipe
